stories.text: Americans vote in midterm elections that will shape Congress for the final years of Trump's presidency and test politics beyond him.
The US carries out strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island before the midterms, with officials calling the attacks limited and defensive, CBS reports.
The UK and EU reach a draft deal cutting Brexit paperwork on food exports, the biggest part of the reset so far.
Thousands of European troops will rehearse a Ukraine deployment in the event of peace, and officials say the force would not join offensive operations.
The prime minister plans a debt reset for Commonwealth nations as talks begin on a formal UK apology for the slave trade within a year.
Investigators say a jet may have broken up before its deadly crash in Florida, and weather could be a factor, though the cause is not yet known.
A Watchdog investigation of 25 items from online sites including Amazon and Temu finds jewellery sold as sterling silver containing toxic chemicals.
Home Secretary Mahmood drops settlement plans for migrant care workers and sets out a revised proposal on when migrants can gain permanent residency.
North Korea denies carrying out the record 6.3 billion dollar hack of Binance, which US agencies and cyber analysts have blamed on Pyongyang.
Collins names mogging, a slang term for outshining or upstaging someone, as its word of the year among 10 words celebrated.
